verdicts.reason: A: the background circles are scattered with no logic (a stray brown disc on the right, a squashed ellipse at the bottom), the SUNSET SALE label is jammed between the body copy and the CTA, the CTA button sits on top of the legal text, the SOLSTICE logo is microscopic, and the SUMMER ONLY badge competes with the headline. B: it has the same CTA-on-legal collision and tiny logo, and SUNSET SALE ends up below its own supporting copy, but the large circle gives the product a coherent backdrop and the headline-then-product-then-CTA flow reads more intentionally, so B is the less broken of the two.
